legend: A rooted tree is a non-directed connected graph without any cycles with a distinguished vertex, which is called the tree root. Consider the vertices of a rooted tree, that consists of n vertices, numbered from 1 to n. In this problem the tree root is the vertex number 1.
Let's represent the length of the shortest by the number of edges path in the tree between vertices v and u as d(v, u).

A parent of vertex v in the rooted tree with the root in vertex r (v ≠ r) is vertex pv, such that d(r, pv) + 1 = d(r, v) and d(pv, v) = 1. For example, on the picture the parent of vertex v = 5 is vertex p5 = 2.

One day Polycarpus came across a rooted tree, consisting of n vertices. The tree wasn't exactly ordinary: it had strings written on its edges. Polycarpus positioned the tree on the plane so as to make all edges lead from top to bottom if you go from the vertex parent to the vertex (see the picture). For any edge that lead from vertex pv to vertex v (1 < v ≤ n), he knows string sv that is written on it. All strings are written on the edges from top to bottom. For example, on the picture s7="ba". The characters in the strings are numbered starting from 0.

Polycarpus defines the position in this tree as a specific letter on a specific string. The position is written as a pair of integers (v, x) that means that the position is the x-th letter of the string sv (1 < v ≤ n, 0 ≤ x < |sv|), where |sv| is the length of string sv. For example, the highlighted letters are positions (2, 1) and (3, 1).

Let's consider the pair of positions (v, x) and (u, y) in Polycarpus' tree, such that the way from the first position to the second goes down on each step. We will consider that the pair of such positions defines string z. String z consists of all letters on the way from (v, x) to (u, y), written in the order of this path. For example, in the picture the highlighted positions define string "bacaba".

Polycarpus has a string t, he wants to know the number of pairs of positions that define string t. Note that the way from the first position to the second in the pair must go down everywhere. Help him with this challenging tree-string problem!
input: The first line contains integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 105) — the number of vertices of Polycarpus's tree. Next n - 1 lines contain the tree edges. The i-th of them contains number pi + 1 and string si + 1 (1 ≤ pi + 1 ≤ n; pi + 1 ≠ (i + 1)). String si + 1 is non-empty and consists of lowercase English letters. The last line contains string t. String t consists of lowercase English letters, its length is at least 2.
It is guaranteed that the input contains at most 3·105 English letters.
output: Print a single integer — the required number.
Please, do not use the %lld specifier to read or write 64-bit integers in С++. It is preferred to use the cin, cout streams or the %I64d specifier.
note: In the first test case string "aba" is determined by the pairs of positions: (2, 0) and (5, 0); (5, 2) and (6, 1); (5, 2) and (3, 1); (4, 0) and (4, 2); (4, 4) and (4, 6); (3, 3) and (3, 5).
Note that the string is not defined by the pair of positions (7, 1) and (5, 0), as the way between them doesn't always go down.

examples.input:
7
1 ab
5 bacaba
1 abacaba
2 aca
5 ba
2 ba
aba

7
1 ab
5 bacaba
1 abacaba
2 aca
5 ba
2 ba
bacaba

legend.ai: 有根树是一个无向连通且无环的图，其中有一个指定的顶点，称为树根。考虑一棵由 n 个顶点组成的有根树，其顶点编号为 1 到 n。在本题中，树根是编号为 1 的顶点。
将树中顶点 v 和 u 之间最短路径的边数记为 d(v, u)。
在根为顶点 r 的有根树中，对于 v ≠ r，顶点 v 的父节点是顶点 p_v，满足 d(r, p_v) + 1 = d(r, v) 且 d(p_v, v) = 1。例如，在图中，顶点 v = 5 的父节点是顶点 p_5 = 2。

一天，Polycarpus 遇到了一棵由 n 个顶点组成的有根树。这棵树并不完全普通：它的边上写有字符串。Polycarpus 将这棵树放置在平面上，使得从父节点走向子节点时，所有边都从上到下延伸（见图）。对于从顶点 p_v 到顶点 v 的任意一条边（1 < v ≤ n），他知道边上写着的字符串 s_v。所有字符串都沿着从上到下的方向写在边上。例如，在图中，s_7 = "ba"。字符串中的字符编号从 0 开始。
Polycarpus 将树中的一个位置定义为某个字符串中的一个特定字符。位置表示为一对整数 (v, x)，表示该位置是字符串 s_v 中的第 x 个字符（1 < v ≤ n，0 ≤ x < |s_v|），其中 |s_v| 是字符串 s_v 的长度。例如，图中标出的字符对应的位置为 (2, 1) 和 (3, 1)。
考虑 Polycarpus 的树中的两个位置 (v, x) 和 (u, y)，并且从第一个位置到第二个位置的路径在每一步都向下。我们称这样的一对位置定义了字符串 z。字符串 z 由从 (v, x) 到 (u, y) 的路径上的所有字符组成，并按照路径经过的顺序排列。例如，在图中，标出的位置定义了字符串 "bacaba"。
Polycarpus 有一个字符串 t，他想知道有多少对位置能够定义字符串 t。注意，一对位置中从第一个位置到第二个位置的路径必须始终向下。请帮助他解决这个具有挑战性的树上字符串问题！

input.ai: 第一行包含整数 n（2 ≤ n ≤ 10^5）——Polycarpus 的树的顶点数。接下来的 n - 1 行包含树的边。其中第 i 行包含数字 p_{i+1} 和字符串 s_{i+1}（1 ≤ p_{i+1} ≤ n；p_{i+1} ≠ (i + 1)）。字符串 s_{i+1} 非空，由小写英文字母组成。最后一行包含字符串 t。字符串 t 由小写英文字母组成，长度至少为 2。
保证输入中至多包含 3·10^5 个英文字母。

output.ai: 输出一个整数——所求的数量。
请不要在 C++ 中使用 %lld 格式说明符来读写 64 位整数。建议使用 cin、cout 流，或使用 %I64d 格式说明符。

note.ai: 注意，位置对 (7, 1) 和 (5, 0) 并不能定义该字符串，因为它们之间的路径并不总是向下。
